_comment: One object per strategy, newest first. Rendered as cards on /research/ and /research/strategies/ by /assets/js/strategy.js. Every figure must come from the strategy's report; give its basis in 'basis'.

strategies.title: Trading the Shape of the Fed Funds Curve Around FOMC Meetings
strategies.line: A meeting-hedged calendar basket in 30-Day Fed Funds futures that cancels every scheduled FOMC decision and trades the residual deviation.
strategies.basis: 1-minute backtest, 30 Sep 2025 to 24 Sep 2026, mid fills, net of fees
